P01.rationale: No founder portrait or dominant human anchor appears anywhere on the page; only text and abstract graphics are present.

P05.rationale: There is no case study with a named client portrait at meaningful size — the layout contains no such visual element.

P07.rationale: A testimonial quote block appears in the right column, but it lacks any press logos or rating cards to constitute full social-proof apparatus.

P10.rationale: The large ‘02’ numeral functions as an oversized decorative typographic element that anchors the right-hand panel visually.

P11.rationale: No real data-visualisations bound to numbers (e.g., before/after charts, cost-math) are present — only abstract text blocks and a testimonial.

P12.rationale: The page reads as dense magazine-quality editorial layout with tightly packed columns, justified text, and layered typographic hierarchy filling the sheet.

P13.rationale: A subtle off-white paper texture provides atmospheric background appropriate to a consulting report, avoiding flat blankness.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion does not apply — no scrim treatment needed or present.

P16.rationale: No device/product mockup (phone/laptop/book) is shown to add product credibility; only typographic and textual elements appear.

N07.rationale: Imagery consists entirely of typography and abstract shapes — no specific business imagery exists, making it inherently generic by absence of real visuals.

N08.rationale: Minimal dead whitespace; the layout is tightly composed with justified text blocks and balanced column widths leaving little empty space.

N10.rationale: No text sits on busy photos without scrim — there are no photographs at all on this page to create such a conflict.
